settings.models.creditStrategy.label: Credit- / Failover-Strategie
settings.models.creditStrategy.explanati: When the active account hits its credit limit, switch to the next configured account on the same provider and keep using the same model.
Once credits are exhausted, fall back to the configured fallback LLM (with its own provider, model, and key) for the remainder of the conversation.
Pause execution until the provider's quota window resets, then resume on the same account. Use this when continuity matters more than throughput.
When credits run out, move CLI work to a new session on another provider using a compact handoff; same-provider recovery stays in the current session.
